# Landman Properties Ltd

> Professional property management company in Kenya serving residential and commercial property owners.

## Core services
- Property management: day-to-day oversight of managed properties.
- Tenant management: tenant communication, onboarding and tenancy support.
- Rent collection: organised rent collection and payment follow-up for property owners.
- Property letting: marketing and tenant placement for available properties.
- Property maintenance: coordinating repairs and routine property care.
- Property inspections: property condition checks and reporting.
- Property marketing: promoting properties to suitable prospective tenants or buyers.
- Portfolio reporting: clear updates to owners on property performance and activity.

## Audience
Property owners, landlords and investors seeking professional residential or commercial property management services in Kenya.
